about: The image-conditions lane's test filters (plan 0.8), written here once: CI's image-conditions job (.github/workflows/v3-ci.yml) and eng/test-fast.ps1 -ImageConditions run each test app with its filter. `lex_v3_tests`: Lex.V3.Tests whole but the two classes that drive tools the image does not carry (the OCI verifier's pwsh, the SDK's publish). `ingest_request_time`: the request-time Lex.V3.Ingest.Tests classes, the mounts the API serves and what it answers from them, and the image-only annex control case; the derive-time classes (V3FirstMountBuildTests, the build and its command line; V3GenerationRetentionTests; V3JourneyMountTests, the journey mounts' writers) run in the dotnet job. A term that names no test selects or excludes nothing, silently, so each test app holds every term of its own filter to a test it has (ImageConditionsLane, beside this file, and each app's ImageConditionsLaneTests).
